claims.text: Oxidation resistance in MPEAs at 800–1200 °C is governed by rapid Al transport to the surface and formation of a continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale.
Retention of mechanical integrity is governed by formation of the protective Al2O3 scale.
A critical bulk Al concentration of approximately 3–5 at.% is sufficient to produce the protective scale.
A continuous Al2O3 scale reduces further oxygen ingress.
Reduced oxygen ingress preserves substrate strength.
The proposed low-Al starting MPEA is single-phase FCC.
The proposed starting material has a grain size of approximately 50 µm.
The proposed starting material has minimal pre-existing oxides.
Increasing bulk Al from 1 at.% to 5 at.% increases the chemical-potential gradient driving Al toward the surface.
The increased chemical-potential gradient raises the diffusion flux of Al to the surface.
The enhanced Al flux enables rapid formation of a continuous Al2O3 barrier that passivates the alloy and blocks further oxygen ingress.
After oxidation at 1000 °C for 100 h, the 5 at.% Al alloy will have more than 50% lower mass gain than the 1 at.% Al alloy.
After oxidation at 1000 °C for 100 h, the 5 at.% Al alloy will form a continuous Al2O3 scale at least 1 µm thick.
The 5 at.% Al alloy will retain at least 20% more high-temperature tensile strength than the 1 at.% Al baseline.
The 1 at.% Al baseline has a mass gain of approximately 5 mg/cm² after 100 h at 1000 °C.
The 1 at.% Al baseline forms sporadic Cr- and Fe-oxide islands.
The 1 at.% Al baseline retains approximately 60% of its tensile strength.
The proposed mechanism holds between 3 and 10 at.% Al for FCC MPEAs exposed to dry air at 800–1200 °C.
The proposed mechanism remains applicable for exposure times up to 1000 h.
Above 10 at.% Al, phase changes may invalidate the proposed behavior.

contradictions.description: Increasing Al from 1 to 5 at.% while keeping every other element's atomic percentage constant is compositionally impossible because atomic percentages must renormalize to 100%. The design should instead specify that the relative ratios of the non-Al elements remain constant.
